name: feature-044-social-address-reflex
description: Social Address Reflex — a pending-address marker on the spoken-to agent (set by ConversationManager.openOrContribute, rendered as a guaranteed + fresh address line via the spec 043 perception bridge), a soft System 1 trigger forcing the target's next scheduler cycle with round-robin priority, marker clearing/decay with the conversation lifecycle, and addressed/reply events for reply-rate measurement. Companion to spec 043; depends on 043 landing first. Issue #160.
